profile.summary: Documentary-style photograph of a worker inside a working garment factory, handling garments at a work table under overhead fluorescent light, shot head-on at eye level with natural colour and a softly blurred workshop behind.
profile.settings: Indoor garment production floor: a light wooden cutting or finishing table in the foreground, an internal glass partition wall with white aluminium frames and half-open horizontal venetian blinds, and a production area visible through the glass with clothing racks, sewing stations, cables and storage.
profile.background: Real working environment left in place, not cleared or styled; glass partition with grey-white blinds and reflections of ceiling strip lights, factory clutter (racks, bins, machines) rendered as soft out-of-focus shapes; plain off-white walls; paperwork, plastic sleeves and tape marks visible on the table edge.
profile.colour: Natural, moderately muted saturation; neutral palette of off-white, light grey and cool grey from walls and blinds, warm honey-beige pine wood from table and hangers, black and beige clothing, white garments; small dull accents of blue and red in the blurred background; slight cool cast in the background against warmer foreground wood.
profile.lighting: Ambient overhead fluorescent and LED strip lighting from the factory ceiling, even and diffuse, soft top-down fill on the face with gentle shadows under the brow and chin; visible ceiling light reflections in the glass; no flash or studio lighting look.
profile.rendering: Digital camera with a fast normal-to-short-telephoto lens at a wide aperture; shallow depth of field with the subject and table sharp and the background behind glass softly blurred; clean image with very little grain; natural skin with visible texture and light retouching only; realistic fabric and wood grain detail, slight scuffs and wear on surfaces left visible.
profile.casting: One factory worker at a time, adult, in everyday work clothes, shown doing their actual job; no models or posed groups.
profile.poseAndEnergy: Still, focused and quiet; subject looking down at the task with hands busy on a garment and hanger, not acknowledging the camera; calm, attentive, candid working moment.
profile.framing: Landscape, wide-ish horizontal frame (about 16:10), straight-on eye-level view; subject centred and shown from the waist up behind the table, with the table running across the lower third as a horizontal foreground band; generous space on both sides showing the surrounding workspace; frame lines of the glass partition give vertical structure.
profile.avoid: Studio backdrops, seamless paper, flash or strobe lighting, heavy skin smoothing, high-gloss commercial retouching, oversaturated or stylised colour grading, dramatic low-key or coloured lighting, posed eye contact with the camera, staged fashion poses, empty spotless showroom spaces, wide-angle distortion, black-and-white treatment, heavy film grain.

profile.summary: Outdoor swimwear photographs taken in strong natural daylight on beaches and in sunlit garden courtyards, showing one model per frame up close in warm, saturated colour with the garment as the clear focal point.
profile.settings: Sandy beaches with turquoise and blue sea and a pale horizon; weathered wooden posts, plank tables and carved dark-wood furniture at the shoreline; Mediterranean-style garden courtyards with whitewashed walls, stone archways, climbing green foliage, pampas and dune grasses, white linen sheets spread on the ground; small props such as wicker baskets of lemons, red apples, white daisies tucked in hair, lavender sprigs.
profile.background: Real locations, not studio sets; backgrounds are softly blurred but recognisable: blue-turquoise sea bands with white surf, beige sand, green leaves, off-white plaster walls, cream fabric; in overhead shots the background is the sand surface itself with visible ripples, footprints and small pebbles.
profile.colour: Warm, fairly saturated palette with golden-tan skin tones; recurring colours are sand beige, sea turquoise and sky blue, leaf and olive green, whitewash white, and swimwear accents in hot pink, lemon yellow, coral-red florals, forest green and brown-black animal prints; whites stay slightly warm, shadows stay brown rather than grey.
profile.lighting: Direct natural sunlight, often high midday sun or low golden late-afternoon sun, producing hard-edged shadows under straps and along limbs, bright highlights on shoulders and cheekbones, and visible cast shadows on sand; garden shots use softer open shade or dappled light through leaves; no visible flash or studio fill.
profile.rendering: Shot like a full-frame digital camera with a short telephoto or standard prime at wide aperture: subject sharp, background melting into soft bokeh; crisp fabric texture showing ruching, seams, ties and print detail; skin keeps visible texture, faint freckles, fine hair and natural creases, lightly cleaned but not smoothed into plastic; clean files with little to no grain; slight natural contrast, no heavy filters.
profile.casting: One woman per frame (a triptych panel may show three separate single-model crops); adult female models in their twenties with sun-tanned skin, long dark brown or black hair worn loose, sometimes with a thin braid or flowers in the hair; natural minimal makeup.
profile.poseAndEnergy: Mostly still, posed but relaxed: leaning against a post with head tilted back and eyes closed toward the sun, reclining on a white sheet propped on one arm, lying flat on sand with arms stretched overhead, holding a piece of fruit near the face; wind-blown hair adds slight motion; mood is sun-soaked, slow, sensual summer holiday.
profile.framing: Tight to medium crops that centre the swimwear: portrait-format three-quarter shots from head to upper thigh, torso-only crops cutting the face at the chin, a wide horizontal overhead shot looking straight down at a figure on sand; subject fills most of the frame, often placed slightly off-centre with sea or foliage filling the remaining edge; eye-level or slightly above camera height.
profile.avoid: Plain seamless studio backdrops, white e-commerce cutouts, flat on-camera flash, grey overcast or cold blue light, desaturated or monochrome grading, heavy film grain or vintage filters, wide-angle distortion, distant full-body shots where the garment is small, groups of people, urban streets or interiors, airbrushed plastic-looking skin, oily or glossy skin sheen, glamour-style dramatic retouching.

profile.summary: Warm, sunlit swimwear lifestyle photos made in a small overgrown courtyard garden, with one model posed among cream stucco walls, ferns, climbing ivy, white wrought-iron furniture, wicker baskets, cut roses, daisies and lemons, shot in a soft film-like look with muted vintage colour.
profile.settings: A walled courtyard garden in a Mediterranean-villa style: cream and off-white stucco walls, classical columns, pilasters and urns, a weathered white-painted greenhouse window with old glass, stone and pale concrete paving, flowerbeds and potted plants; props include ornate white cast-iron garden chairs and a round lace-pattern table, a rustic unpainted wooden stool, a small white-painted wooden step stool, a white linen picnic blanket, a dark wooden board, and wicker baskets of lemons, apples and pink roses.
profile.background: Real outdoor backgrounds, close and layered, never plain: ferns, ivy, climbing vines, tall grass blades, purple lupins, blue delphiniums, hydrangeas and white flowers frame the edges and often sit in the foreground; behind them are stained, mottled stucco walls or a blue-grey weathered plaster wall; backgrounds go soft but you can still tell what they are, and some frames fall into deep green-black shadow areas.
profile.colour: Warm, slightly faded colour with medium-low saturation and a golden-amber cast: warm tan skin tones, cream, ivory and chalky white, blush and dusty pink, peach and coral floral prints, butter and lemon yellow, sage, fern and deep bottle green, with small touches of lavender and periwinkle; blacks are lifted and gently matte, highlights are warm rather than pure white, greens lean olive.
profile.lighting: Natural daylight only: direct sun from the side or behind, at a low-to-mid angle like late morning or afternoon, leaving hard warm highlights on shoulders, legs and hair and crisp dappled shadows from leaves and wrought-iron patterns on paving and walls; occasional soft lens flare or haze in the frame; contrast runs from bright sunlit patches into darker shaded greenery, with some frames set in open shade with even, softer light.
profile.rendering: Looks like a full-frame camera with a 35-85mm lens at a moderate aperture: the subject sharp, the background softly blurred but recognisable; a light film-emulation grade with gentle grain and soft, lifted shadows; natural skin texture with visible pores, freckles, small creases and tan variation kept; minimal retouching, no smoothing or plastic finish; foreground grass and leaves sometimes blurred right in front of the lens.
profile.casting: A single female model per image, a woman in her twenties with a sun-tanned complexion and long dark hair worn loose, decorated with small white daisies or similar flowers; no groups, no men, no children.
profile.poseAndEnergy: Mostly relaxed and still, close to an editorial or romantic storybook feel: leaning on stools or tables, reclining on garden chairs or a blanket, sitting on the ground, reading, holding or smelling a single rose, carrying a basket; occasionally a light moment of motion such as a twirl with hair swinging; expressions are calm, dreamy or softly smiling, the gaze either at the camera or down at a prop.
profile.framing: Mostly portrait-orientation crops from the knees or thighs up, plus some three-quarter and full-body views and one wide panoramic banner; the model is often off-centre, with props and plants filling the remaining space; eye-level or slightly high camera; foreground foliage overlaps the frame edges; uncropped headroom is tight, sometimes cutting just above the head.
profile.avoid: Studio seamless backdrops, plain white or flat colour walls, beaches, pools, sea and sand, urban street scenes, flash or ring-light look, cool blue or grey grading, neon or highly saturated colour, heavy contrast HDR, airbrushed or smoothed skin, digital-clean sharpness without grain, multiple models, posed catalogue stances against a grid, product-only flat lays, night or artificial lighting.

profile.summary: Bright, sun-lit outdoor swimwear photographs in tropical beach and garden locations, alongside high-key daylight photographs of an empty working sewing floor, all shot as clean, natural-looking digital photography with true-to-life colour.
profile.settings: Sandy tropical beaches with turquoise sea and breaking white surf behind a white 1960s convertible with red upholstery; a rough whitewashed limestone wall in full sun next to a pale concrete path; a shaded tropical garden with large banana leaves, bamboo poles, palm trunks, a weathered grey-white wall and a dark pool edge; tall pale beach grass and flowering vines in sand dunes; a garment factory sewing room with rows of cream industrial sewing machines on white tables with orange-edged tops, wooden chairs, cardboard boxes, beige ceramic floor tiles, overhead fluorescent rails, large bright windows and stacks of teal and black fabric.
profile.background: Real locations with no studio backdrops. Backgrounds stay recognisable but are softened by depth of field: sea and sky as broad blue bands, foliage as blurred green masses, and stone walls as close, textured, sunlit surfaces filling the frame. Wide banner versions fade into a dark slate-navy gradient across the left third, leaving room for text. Factory shots show deep, receding rows of machines toward a bright window wall.
profile.colour: Natural to slightly raised saturation. Strong cerulean sky, turquoise and teal sea, chalk white and cream stone, sand beige, olive and leaf green, and warm golden-brown skin tones, with accents of tomato red, cobalt blue and coral floral print. Garden shots are warmer and amber-tinted with deep green shadows. Factory shots are high-key with cool whites, cream machine bodies, pale beige tiles, small teal and red accents and warm orange table edges. No heavy colour grade.
profile.lighting: Outdoor shots use hard, direct tropical sun from high or side angles, with crisp dark shadows, bright highlights on stone and car paint, and squinting or eyes-closed faces turned toward the sun. Garden and dune shots use low, warm late-afternoon sun coming through leaves and grass, with dappled light, rim light on hair and some flare haze. Factory shots use even overhead fluorescent tubes plus flat window daylight, bright and nearly shadowless. No flash or studio strobes.
profile.rendering: Clean full-frame digital look. Portrait shots use roughly 50–85mm focal lengths with moderately shallow depth of field and a soft but readable background, sometimes with blurred grass blades in the foreground. Subjects are sharp, with low noise and no visible film grain. Retouching is light: skin keeps pores, fine body hair, sand specks, tan variation and natural creases, and fabric texture and stitching stay visible. Factory shots use a wide lens with deep focus, sharp detail across the room and slightly lifted exposure.
profile.casting: Adult women in their twenties with a mix of skin tones, from light to deep brown, and long dark, brown or sun-streaked hair. Some frames show one woman, others a group of three. Factory images show no people, only workstations.
profile.poseAndEnergy: Relaxed, posed-candid fashion poses with slight movement: leaning on a car, a wall or stone, reclining, sitting on the car's rear deck while looking back over a shoulder, shading eyes with a raised arm, adjusting a strap, sipping from a fruit or holding a flowering stem. The mood is sunny, carefree holiday fashion, with closed-eye sun-soaking moments and occasional open laughs. Factory shots are still, orderly and quiet, like a working floor between shifts.
profile.framing: Wide panoramic banners about 2.7:1 with subjects in the right half to two-thirds and text space on the left, plus tall portrait crops about 1:2 to 3:4. People are cropped from mid-thigh or knee up, sometimes as tight torso crops with the head cut off. Camera height is at the subject or slightly lower. Group shots are spread in a loose row or staggered in depth. Factory frames use a diagonal one-point perspective down rows of tables, shot from standing eye height.
profile.avoid: Studio seamless backdrops, night or overcast scenes, black-and-white, heavy film grain or vintage film emulation, strong teal-and-orange cinematic grading, HDR halos, on-camera flash, plastic airbrushed skin, fully blurred bokeh-only backgrounds, urban street or office settings, people posed inside the factory shots, and dark, moody or desaturated factory lighting.

profile.summary: Warm, sunlit lifestyle photographs of one woman at a time lounging in a whitewashed Mediterranean-style garden courtyard full of greenery, fruit and cut flowers, plus the occasional plain documentary shot of a worker at a garment-factory finishing table.
profile.settings: Private garden courtyards and patios: cream limestone columns and plastered walls, a rough whitewashed fieldstone wall, pale concrete or sandstone paving, white ornate cast-iron garden chairs and a round table, a weathered unpainted wooden stool, white linen sheets spread over the ground beside ornamental grasses, ferns, ivy, banana leaves and bamboo poles. Props include wicker baskets of lemons and apples, a whole pineapple, pink roses, white daisies tucked into hair, pink carnation-like bouquets and an open paperback. For production scenes: a factory finishing room with a long plywood worktable, stacks of wooden hangers and white garments, glass partitions with half-closed venetian blinds, and ceiling fluorescent tubes.
profile.background: Real on-location backdrops rather than seamless ones: cream or white stone and plaster walls, or dense dark-green foliage, kept slightly out of focus but still recognisable. Backgrounds often split between a bright sunlit wall and a deep shadowed plant area. In the factory, a soft-focus room behind glass with blinds and workers' shapes.
profile.colour: Warm, moderately saturated, golden-hour grading. Palette of cream, chalk white, sand beige, deep fern and banana-leaf green, sage and olive green, lemon yellow, blush and rose pink, coral-red floral prints, and warm tan skin tones. Shadows sit in deep green-brown to near-black, highlights warm ivory. The factory shot is more neutral, with grey-white walls, black clothing and the honey tone of raw wood.
profile.lighting: Hard, direct natural sunlight from a low-to-mid sun angle, late afternoon in feel. It casts crisp shadows, including lacy patterned shadows from cast-iron furniture on paving, with leaf-dappled patches and the occasional soft sun haze or flare near the frame edge. Strong contrast between sunlit planes and dark foliage. Indoors: even, flat overhead fluorescent light with no added flash.
profile.rendering: Digital camera look with 35-85mm focal lengths at moderate apertures: subject sharp, background gently blurred but readable, foreground plants sometimes soft. Clean, low noise, slight film-like warmth. Light retouching only: skin keeps freckles, pores, faint tan lines, small marks and fine body hair visible, and hair has loose flyaways. Fabric shows real stretch, puckering at seams and ruffles.
profile.casting: A single person per frame, always. Adult women in their twenties to early thirties with mixed complexions, mostly dark long hair, with one lighter blonde. In production shots, one female factory worker in everyday work clothing and a headscarf. No men, couples or groups.
profile.poseAndEnergy: Still and unhurried. Reclining on linen, leaning on a stool, sitting back in a garden chair with legs extended, arching back against a stone wall, or standing loosely. Hands are busy with props: holding an apple, plucking rose petals, reading a book, sipping from a pineapple through a metal straw. Eyes are often lowered or closed, sometimes a calm direct look into the lens or an open laugh. The mood is relaxed, sensual and summery. The worker is absorbed in hanging a garment.
profile.framing: Mostly eye-level or slightly high angles. Tight crops cut off the top of the head, feet or hands at the frame edge. Subject is usually placed off-centre, often right of frame, with props or furniture filling the other side. Formats are portrait 4:5 to 9:16 and very wide 2.4:1 to 2.7:1 web banners with the body stretched diagonally across the frame. The factory shot is frontal, centred, medium-wide, with the worktable running across the foreground.
profile.avoid: Studio seamless or coloured paper backdrops, on-camera or studio flash, cool blue or teal grading, black-and-white, neon or night scenes, city streets, open beach and ocean horizon panoramas, crowds or multiple models, men, sporty action or motion blur, heavy airbrushed plastic-looking skin, HDR halos, heavy vignettes, and text or graphic overlays baked into the image.

garments.prints: About half the products are plain solids. The solids are clear, saturated summer colours: sunflower yellow, bubblegum/hot pink, olive/khaki green, optic white, powder blue and cherry red. The main print is a soft painterly floral, used on many pieces. It has small-to-medium tossed blooms such as roses, poppies and ditsy buds in coral, tomato red, peach and candy pink, with mint/sage leaves, on a blush, cream or apricot ground. The repeat is dense and all-over with no directional layout. A smaller set uses a medium-scale abstract animal print with brushstroke zebra/leopard marks in espresso brown and black on sand/greige, and a blurred indigo-and-white tie-dye/batik print. Florals are often paired with a solid dark forest-green accent, and tops and bottoms are always cut from the same print or colour.
garments.fabrics: Smooth, matte-to-soft-satin stretch swim jersey (nylon/elastane look), with a clean, fully lined feel. Some solids have a fine all-over shimmer or glitter sheen (the pink). Others have a subtle crinkle or rib texture (the red) or a slightly textured crepe/piqué-like surface (the white one-piece). The olive pieces are a dense, flat matte knit. The printed fabrics have a soft, slightly glossy finish.
garments.trims: Contrast binding and straps in dark forest green on the florals. An ecru crochet/macramé lace tape threaded with black cord in a lattice runs along the cup tops and bottom side panels. Round black cord ties end in small metal bullet/cylinder tips. Thin spaghetti string ties at the sides and back, and thin self-fabric straps. Self-fabric back ties are knotted into bows with long tails. There are small gold or silver metal strap sliders and adjusters, and gold metal hook clasps at the centre back. No beads.
garments.cuts: Tops: sliding triangle with an elastic hem channel, halter triangle, underwire balconette with a dipped centre notch, twist/ruched bandeau with spaghetti straps, sweetheart top with wide straps and a tie-back, strapless tube bandeau, and a scoop-neck sports-style top with buckle back. One-pieces: square/scoop-neck tank with wide contrast straps, deep-plunge halter, and a high-leg plunge with side ties and lattice lacing. Bottoms: high-leg cheeky, thong/tanga, string tie-side, V-front high-cut, and a double-string side bottom with two parallel straps on each hip.
garments.details: Gathering at the centre front, cup bases and the centre back seam of bottoms (scrunch effect). Elastic casing channels on the triangle hems and bottom sides. Clean bound or turned edges, often in a contrast colour. Centre-front tie closures with cord. Double-strap and lattice/ladder lacing at the sides. Adjustable straps throughout. Lightly moulded or padded cups on underwire styles. Fabric bows and knotted ties at the back. Every piece is designed as a matching set.

Bottoms: high-leg cheeky, thong/tanga, string tie-side, V-front high-cut, and a double-string side bottom with two parallel straps on each hip.
garments.details: Gathering at the centre front, cup bases and the centre back seam of bottoms (scrunch effect). Elastic casing channels on the triangle hems and bottom sides. Clean bound or turned edges, often in a contrast colour. Centre-front tie closures with cord. Double-strap and lattice/ladder lacing at the sides. Adjustable straps throughout. Lightly moulded or padded cups on underwire styles. Fabric bows and knotted ties at the back. Every piece is designed as a matching set.

plain.from: About half the products are plain solids. The solids are clear, saturated summer colours: sunflower yellow, bubblegum/hot pink, olive/khaki green, optic white, powder blue and cherry red. The main print is a soft painterly floral, used on many pieces. It has small-to-medium tossed blooms such as roses, poppies and ditsy buds in coral, tomato red, peach and candy pink, with mint/sage leaves, on a blush, cream or apricot ground. The repeat is dense and all-over with no directional layout. A smaller set uses a medium-scale abstract animal print with brushstroke zebra/leopard marks in espresso brown and black on sand/greige, and a blurred indigo-and-white tie-dye/batik print. Florals are often paired with a solid dark forest-green accent, and tops and bottoms are always cut from the same print or colour.
